excel.title: Import questions from Excel
excel.intro: Add many questions at once. Each row is one question and says which course and topic it belongs to.
excel.rule1: Fill Course, then Subject, Chapter, Topic and Sub-topic as deep as you need. Missing topics are created.
excel.rule2: Type: MCQ single, MCQ multiple, True/False, Numeric, One word or Long answer.
excel.rule3: Answer: option letters for MCQ (A or A,C), True or False, a number, or the answer text.
excel.rule4: Difficulty is Easy, Medium or Hard. Tags are comma-separated.
excel.unreadable: This file could not be read. Use the template as an .xlsx file.
excel.newTopicsNote: Topics that do not exist yet are created during the import.

problem.badType: Type is not one of the allowed types
problem.fewOptions: an MCQ needs at least two options
problem.badAnswer: Answer does not match the options
problem.badDifficulty: Difficulty must be Easy, Medium or Hard
